structured_output.summary: Under Idaho Code § 63-3024A, each full-year resident who files gets a food tax credit (formerly the grocery credit) of $155 per personal exemption "for tax year 2025 and each year thereafter." Any part of the credit that exceeds the tax due is paid as a refund. The credit has no income limit. It is prorated only for months in which the filer received SNAP, and none is listed here. The engine counted $155 for one person over 12 qualifying months, which matches the statute. The 0 consensus wrongly assumed the credit is nonrefundable or income-limited, and stage 1 was right.
